summary: Approve bf44e39 Stop service before draining during fenced update. The updater now requests systemctl stop first, which stops new dispatches and drains live Runs with no wall-clock deadline (ADR 0020), instead of polling for an idle window while the scheduler could still dispatch new Runs. install-service.sh removes idle_timeout_seconds, poll_interval_seconds, and is_idle; sets service_stopped before stop; and adds an INT/TERM trap so a cancelled update still rolls back to the prior instance. AGENTS.md documents the corrected fence order. deploy_update_test.go adds a real-script regression test that blocks the fake systemctl stop until the drain is released and proves no fast-forward happens before stop. All checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets exit 0), and the SHA fast-forwards origin/master (748b524 is its parent).
